coverTag: A concept for a new seafront landmark at Port de La Mer: the reflected light of Dutch water meets the light of the Gulf.
headline: Where Dutch light meets the Gulf.
opportunity: Gran Meliá Dubai Jumeirah opens on the seafront at Port de La Mer with 380 rooms and suites and event space for up to a thousand guests. At that scale, art does its best work as a recognisable signature: a collection guests associate with the hotel, carried through rooms, suites and events. We propose one built on a simple, beautiful parallel: the reflected light of Dutch water and the light of the Gulf.

reading.title: Water and light
reading.text: The sea is the hotel's protagonist; the art can echo it in every space.

concept.statement: Two Waters connects the canals of Amsterdam with the Gulf coast outside the hotel's windows. Reflections, horizons and the gold of evening light run through every piece, from a signature pair at the arrival to a numbered room series and Living Paintings that can be programmed for events and seasons. A suite collection of originals offers the most exclusive guests a piece of Dutch art they will remember.

email.subject: Two Waters: an art concept for Gran Meliá Dubai Jumeirah
body: Dear Gran Meliá Dubai Jumeirah team,
Congratulations on bringing the first Gran Meliá to Dubai.

I'm Mariska Beenen of Gallery Dutch Art, an Amsterdam studio creating bespoke art and collections for hospitality. Inspired by the hotel's seafront setting at Port de La Mer, we prepared a short concept, "Two Waters": a collection that connects the reflected light of Dutch canals with the light of the Gulf, with a signature pair at the arrival, a suite collection of originals and Living Paintings that can be programmed for events.
Would you be open to a twenty-minute conversation in the coming weeks?

Warm regards,
Mariska Beenen
Gallery Dutch Art · Amsterdam
gallerydutchart@gmail.com · www.gallerydutchart.nl
If this isn't relevant, simply reply "no" and I won't follow up.
